<reason>A won a tight, high-quality clash by keeping a live distinction B kept collapsing: consent to simulated romance is not consent to using disclosed vulnerabilities as a retention tool. The Q1 exchange forced B to permit exploiting abandonment fear if checkout is honest; A crystallized that as the vote.
